transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE
transactions.description: A00005 CH0009 NPP BRIDGE ALIGNMENT AND CH00010 CWS MAINTENANCE PUMP.  BRIDGE WAS NOT ALIGNED CORRECTLY IN PLANS AND SPECS.  PUMPS WERE NOT SIZED CORRECTLY IN PLANS AND SPECS.  MOD FIXES THIS.

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE
transactions.description: A00006 TUNNEL 6 CONNECTION TO SHAFT 5.  CONNECTION SHOWN IN THE DRAWINGS WAS INCORRECT.  NEW DRAWINGS PRODUCED AND INCORPORATED INTO THE CONTRACT.

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE
transactions.description: P00008 ROCK EXCAVATION QUANTITY SHAFT 6 AND CONNECTION TUNNEL.  PLANS HAD AN ERROR IN THE CALCULATION OF QUANTITY FOR EXCAVATION.  THIS MOD CORRECTS FOR THAT CORRECT QUANTITY.

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE
transactions.description: A00007 OLD NPP BRIDGE REPAIR/STABILIZATION.  THE OLD NPP BRIDGE IS IN POOR CONDITION AND THERE IS A CONCERN THAT IT WILL NOT LAST UNTIL THE REPLACEMENT STRUCTURE IS READY.  THIS MOD PERFORMS SOME WORK TO REACH THAT GOAL.

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE
transactions.description: A00008 NPP BRIDGE REBAR AND SCUPPERS.  BRIDGE DECK DOES NOT HAVE ENOUGH SCUPPERS TO ADDRESS DRAINAGE.  ADDITIONALLY, THE DECK WAS NOT LEVEL FOR DRAINAGE.  THIS MOD ADDS SCUPPERS, REBAR, AND ADJUSTS DECK SLOPE.

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE
transactions.description: A00009 CENTER DIKE GRADING AT UNIT 10.  UNIT 10 WAS NOT SET FOR DRAINAGE CORRECTLY IN THE PLANS AND DID NOT SLOPE MATERIAL AROUND THE UNIT 10 POWER PLANT CORRECTLY.

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE
transactions.description: P00009 CELL 6B CONCRETE FILL.  CHANGES CELL 6B TO CONCRETE FROM SAND AS SPECIFIED IN A PRE-BID ENQUIRY.

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE
transactions.description: A00010 UNIT 10 DRAIN PIPE RELOCATION. A DRAINAGE PIPE WAS NOT SHOWN ON THE DRAWINGS BUT WAS SHOWN ON THE HISTORICAL DRAWINGS.  THIS MOD REPLACES THE OLD PIPE WITH NEW.

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE
transactions.description: P00010 DAVIS RECESS FILL.  DURING THE COURSE OF THE PROJECT, IT WAS DISCOVERED THAT THERE WERE A NUMBER OF RECESSES THAT WERE MISSED IN THE ORIGINAL CALCULATION OF QUANTITIES.  THIS INCREASES QUANTITIES OF FILL.

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE

transactions.action_type_description: EXERCISE AN OPTION

transactions.description: MODIFICATION FINALIZING THE YEAR 1 ADJUSTMENT OF THE ECONOMIC PRICE ADJUSTMENT CLAUSE BILATERALLY.

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE
transactions.description: A00014 WEEP HOLES ON UPSTREAM CELLS 1 AND 2A.  THE UPSTREAM COFFERCELLS ARE CONTAINING WATER.  THESE WEEP HOLES SHOULD DRAIN THE CELLS TO EQUALIZE HYDROSTATIC PRESSURE.

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE
transactions.description: A00015 TESTING OF DISCHARGE WATER.  WATER OUTLET FROM THE DEWATERED AREA WAS DISCOVERED TO BE A HIGH PH.  THIS CREATED A CONCERN THAT THERE COULD BE HAZARDOUS MATERIAL IN THE DISCHARGE, SO IT WAS TESTED.

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE
transactions.description: A00016 SOLUTIONS FOR DISCHARGE OF HIGH PH WATER. DETERMINES 3 SOLUTIONS TO REMEDY HIGH PH WATER THAT IS DISCHARGED FROM THE NEW LOCK DEWATERING.

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE
transactions.description: NEW LOCK AT THE SOO - CH0021 NEW PUMP WELL DESIGN AND CONSTRUCTION CHANGES TO CORRECT WATER FLOW.

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE
transactions.description: A00017 TEMPORARY DEWATERING POWER.  ADJUSTS THE LOAD CENTER FOR THE TEMPORARY DEWATERING PUMPS.

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE
transactions.description: A00018 SHIP ARRESTOR MATERIALS.  THE MATERIALS FOR THE SHIP ARRESTORS NEED TO CHANGED TO A DIFFERENT TYPE OF METAL.

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE

transactions.action_type_description: SUPPLEMENTAL AGREEMENT FOR WORK WITHIN SCOPE
